messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing a compact admit_score flow and clear DL semantics. Wanted quick takes before I write the addendum.

maria: TL;DR: compute admit_score (0-100) from weighted checks (perf/correctness/compat). Pre-admit: fast scorecard (<10s) + minimal repro bundle. Deepbench async. Map score buckets to DL actions (GA/canary/hold/quarantine).

tom: +1. Make the admit_score auditable: score_breakdown stored with the bundle (list of check:score). No black-box heuristics.

sree: Compat checks: tokenizer roundtrip + special-token consistency + tiny embedding stability set. Pre-admit use 8 vectors; deepbench 50. If avg cosine drop > 0.02 -> compat fail.

alex: Storage defaults: keep pointers + minimal repro (prompt, token_ids, seed, model_fingerprint). Persist full binaries only if persist_binaries=true for that org or explicit request. Pointers must be immutable (S3 version or dedup key) and we should store a checksum to detect drift.

jen: Telemetry classification: regression vs transient vs invariant-break. Regression -> persisted bundle + alert. Transient (OOM/infra) -> retry 3x ephemeral. Invariant-break (tokenizer mismatch / checksum) -> quarantine + manual sign-off.

sam: Score -> DL mapping idea: >=85 GA; 70-85 canary; 50-70 hold (manual review); <50 quarantine. Make thresholds org-configurable via admission_policy. Add admit_policy.ref enum for pre-baked policies.

infra-bot: infra-bot: onboarding-worker v3 will emit admit_score and score_breakdown fields in ingestion metadata. Canary rollout scheduled next week.

tom: Add a docker-lite repro runner included in the minimal bundle so Console can "replay locally" without pulling big compiled artifacts. Runner should be tiny, deterministic, and seeded.

sree: We need a stable model_fingerprint computed as sha256(tokenizer_map + model_config_json + weights_checksum). Use it to validate pointers and detect drift. Store fingerprint in bundle.

alex: Cost action: I'll quantify pointer-only vs persist-binaries. Also estimate quick-bench vs deepbench $/model.

jen: UX: Console should show admit_score trend, failing check highlight, and a replay button that launches the docker-lite runner and streams logs. Include a short triage button to open an oncall-assigned ticket with run_id.

maria: Defaults I'll document in addendum: weights perf=40 correctness=40 compat=20; thresholds ga=85 canary=70 hold=50; quick_bench_timeout_ms=8000; pointers_ttl_days=30; hold_days=60; quarantine_days=180. Minimal repro blob example included.

alex: Suggestion: admission descriptor add schema_version to allow future split of acceptance_policy vs runtime_profile. Land admit_score as additive to avoid breaking ingestion.

sree: Long-term: keep admission_policy compact; add versioned migration later. For private deployments, replay must run in customer VPC or via an ephemeral remote executor with proper KMS access. Add replay_scope to manifest.

maria: Action items: maria write RFC addendum (due Thu); tom+sree prototype docker-lite runner + tokenizer-shim (PR in 1 week); alex cost model (Fri); jen telemetry spec & alert playbook (next Wed); infra-bot coordinate rollout.

maria: Example minimal repro blob I'll include in RFC (for Console replay):

```json
{
  "repro_prompt": "Translate to French: Hello world",
  "token_ids": [154, 23, 4],
  "seed": 42,
  "model_config": "quantized-int8-v2",
  "checksum": "sha256:abcd...",
  "pointer": "s3://models/registry/123456:v2"
}
```

maria: Thanks all — will circulate the addendum and tag reviewers. @tom @sree @alex @jen @sam :rocket:
